sourceType.description: (required) Source type for which evaluation needs to happen

expression.description: (required) Expression that needs to be inspected

interval.description:
(optional) Interval of evaluation (has to be same for both time ranges). If not specified, mismatch detection will be run
for all intervals viz. QUARTER_HOUR / HOUR / DAY / MONTH / YEAR

timeRange1.description:
(optional) Range 1 for which the expression should be evaluated. If not specified, mismatch detection will be run for
the last 3 years of data and overlapping sub intervals will be calculated for timeRange1 and timeRange2

timeRange2.description:
(optional) Range 2 for which the expression should be evaluated. If not specified, mismatch detection will be run for
the last 3 years of data and overlapping sub intervals will be calculated for timeRange1 and timeRange2
